Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-G10`.

**Outcome:** Trusted scanner/policy changes require independent owners and failing required checks actually prevent merge.

**Owner:** Repository administrator. **Batch:** P0: contracts, inventory and early gates. **Size:** 0.5 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not claim current branch protection exists
- No invented maintainer handles

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `AGENTS.md::PR Conventions` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** .github/CODEOWNERS; docs/plans/v31-server-migration/required-checks.md (planned artifacts; retain existing shared drivers/assertions)

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/AGENTS.md) — `PR Conventions`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [.github/workflows/ci.yml](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/.github/workflows/ci.yml) — `job names`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [.github/workflows/pr-ready.yml](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/.github/workflows/pr-ready.yml) — `pr-ready status`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Current checks and explicit maintainer authority

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Unreviewed allowlist expansion
- Status-only gate described as merge protection

**Writable boundary:**
- .github/CODEOWNERS
- docs/plans/v31-server-migration/required-checks.md

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-G09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745) (**FULFILLED/CLOSED**; retained dependency history)

**Blocks:** [DM31-Q11](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/828)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/738), [DM31-A14](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/739), [DM31-A19](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/740), [DM31-A20](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/741)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Assign actual owners to scanner/policy/workflow/contracts and module paths
- Record before/after API evidence with inaccessible distinct from absent
- Require architecture-conformance, server-ut-st and existing checks under exact verified names
- Verify failing test PR cannot merge; successful updated-head PR can
- If plan/admin capability unavailable, enforcement remains BLOCKED

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Readback:** gh api repos/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/branches/main; administrator retrieves effective protection/rules/check sources and demonstrates blocked negative/correct positive PR under authorized settings.

**Participants:** Repository administrator and actual GitHub branch rules; no admin rights assumed by planning actor.

**Limitation:** Current branch response is unprotected; rulesets read returned403. Activation remains blocked until administrator evidence exists.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** repository-admin, ruleset-or-protection-plan-support. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR10.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

### 🚀 Background Description

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-A21`.

- Frozen main [harness/workswarm/jiuwenswarm/server/runtime/agent_adapter/interface_deep.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/workswarm/jiuwenswarm/server/runtime/agent_adapter/interface_deep.py) — `normal DeepAgent creation`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/755)

**Blocks:** [DM31-M03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/764), [DM31-M04](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/765)

For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

- Normal pairing and final staging preserve immutable input; failure cannot publish successful terminal.

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.st.test_dm31_a21

**Cases:** - Real pinned Core with controlled host gateways
- Actual module-origin evidence
- Failed tool pairing and final-write failure

**Participants:** Actual pinned DeepAgent/task-loop/ReAct construction and run with FakeHostAPI service ports; no old daemon, real network or SDK-owned persistence. This asserts adapter behavior, not complete production assembly.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** main-preservation, Harness. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR0004, code-quality.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-G05`.

**Outcome:** Generic service works without default Core physically installed and packages install without neighboring checkouts or undeclared transitives.

**Owner:** Packaging owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 1 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- Not a default-Harness behavior pass
- No dependency upgrades

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `.github/ci-gates.json::gate catalog` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** scripts/ci/verify_server_install.py; tests/architecture/test_dependency_origins.py; tests/server/st/test_replacement_no_core.py (planned artifacts; retain existing shared drivers/assertions)

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [.github/ci-gates.json](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/.github/ci-gates.json) — `gate catalog`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [tests/server/st/test_harness_loading.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/tests/server/st/test_harness_loading.py) — `HarnessLoadingST; IndependentHarnessFactory`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/harness/plugin.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/harness/plugin.py) — `OpenJiuwenFactory`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/deploy/Dockerfile](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/deploy/Dockerfile) — `dependency installation`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Pinned provider identities and exact recovery binding semantics

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Production imports of tests/fakes/reference snapshot/neighbor paths
- Generic dependencies on default-provider commands

**Writable boundary:**
- scripts/ci/verify_server_install.py
- tests/architecture/test_dependency_origins.py
- tests/server/st/test_replacement_no_core.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759), [DM31-G09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745) (**FULFILLED/CLOSED**; retained dependency history)

**Blocks:** [DM31-A25](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/820)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A10](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/760), [DM31-A21](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/761), [DM31-M01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/762), [DM31-M02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/763)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Independent Harness passes with Core absent, not merely an import blocker
- Missing bound provider fails explicitly instead of fallback
- Clean isolated install and pip check succeed; neighbor PYTHONPATH disabled
- Production-test and undeclared dependency fixtures fail

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 scripts/ci/server-tests.py --suite replacement-no-core --require-tests --fail-on-skip

**Assertions:** - server-tests.py --suite replacement-no-core --require-tests --fail-on-skip (proposed)
- server-tests.py --suite clean-install --require-tests --fail-on-skip (proposed)

**Participants:** Actual scanner and legal/violating fixtures; runtime suites use real owning public components/SQLite with controlled providers. G05 physically omits Core in its isolated installation. No phone/device claim.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** isolated-package-environment, approved-dependency-locks. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR05, AR07.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-G06`.

**Outcome:** Supported old entries route through new public proxies with no old executor, duplicate admission, or competing writer.

**Owner:** Integration owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 1 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not delete supported compatibility APIs
- Do not remove unmigrated business providers

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `architecture@f7dd:server/runtime.py::Runtime` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** tools/architecture/legacy_edges.py; tests/server/st/test_legacy_unreachable.py (planned artifacts; retain existing shared drivers/assertions)

**Source evidence:**
- Architecture reference [server/runtime.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/runtime.py) — `Runtime`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_service.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_service.py) — `EngineService`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [docs/specs/host-operation-lifecycle.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/host-operation-lifecycle.md) — `Owners and public call path`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Observed wire, errors, acceptance, recovery and main feature behavior

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Legacy executor reachability from migrated default path
- Duplicate state authority in compatibility facade

**Writable boundary:**
- tools/architecture/legacy_edges.py
- tests/server/st/test_legacy_unreachable.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-G09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745) (**FULFILLED/CLOSED**; retained dependency history)

**Blocks:** [DM31-M25](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/821)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/750), [DM31-A03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/751), [DM31-A04](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/752), [DM31-A05](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/753)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Scan and test each already-delegated entry incrementally; M25 proves the completed product entry matrix has no old-executor reachability. This task does not wait for every business migration.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- One normal and one consequential failure traced from old public entry
- Old executor sentinel stays zero
- Mutated fallback invoking old executor fails
- Legacy dependencies cannot grow through new feature branches

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 scripts/ci/server-tests.py --suite legacy-unreachable --require-tests --fail-on-skip

**Assertions:** - server-tests.py --suite legacy-unreachable --require-tests --fail-on-skip (proposed)
- Static AR06 fixtures

**Participants:** Actual scanner and legal/violating fixtures; runtime suites use real owning public components/SQLite with controlled providers. G05 physically omits Core in its isolated installation. No phone/device claim.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** compatibility-delegate-implementation. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR01, AR06.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-M01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/762), [DM31-A32](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/758)

**Blocks:** [DM31-M25](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/821)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-M06](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/775), [DM31-M07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/776), [DM31-M11](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/777), [DM31-M26](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/778)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** - Registry/Store exact ownership interfaces

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
**Normal:** Read/dismiss exact notification version and register/remove a scoped subscription.

**Failure:** Stale/foreign notification or expired subscription is explicit; no cross-account push.

**Concurrency:** Dismissing version1 cannot mark newly created version2 read; duplicate provider callback has one projection.


**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.plugin_gateway.st.test_m39_boundary

**Participants:** Real extracted action validators/state transitions, new owning public proxy and temporary domain store; controlled external provider/clock. Execution uses actual Router/AS/Store where required; no device/live vendor claim.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** notification.*, push.*. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR-0001, ADR-0004, AR01, AR04, AR06, AR09.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

## 现象与证据
- 请求时间：2026-11-08 00:28:51，整条请求耗时 300.9s。
- 工具执行共 150.6s，其中 4 次 bash 调用就占了 129.6s（占工具总时间 86%）。
- 明细：R17 = 66.2s、R14 = 28.9s、R15 = 23.4s、R24 = 11.1s。
- 数据来源：step_breakdown_tool_calls.csv；events.jsonl 中 tool-call 到 tool-result 的时间差。

## 影响
- 单条 bash 命令耗时可达 66s，且期间无超时控制、无进度反馈，用户长时间看不到任何反馈，感知为“卡死”，严重拖垮整条请求体验。

## 期望
- 为 bash / 长命令增加可配置超时与心跳进度。
- 超过 5s 输出阶段性进度并允许中断。
- 超长命令支持拆分执行。

## 标签
performance / tooling / P1

## 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

After an app/backend restart, the same English message is shown three times consecutively and is not localized to Chinese.

Observed message (repeated 3×):
```
The interaction expired after restart. Start a fresh task after reviewing earlier effects.
```

## Steps to reproduce
1. Restart the app/backend.
2. Resume the existing conversation and send a message.
3. Observe the reply area.

## Expected result
- Recover the session; localize the notice to Chinese; show the notice only once.

## Actual result
- An English notice is shown three times in a row.

## Possible cause (inferred, not code-verified)
- Session state is not persisted/restored across restart; the notice is not localized and is appended repeatedly.

## Detailed Environment Information Description
- App: DigitalMate (package `com.jiuwen.digitalmate`), mobile client
- Platform: Android phone
- Timezone: Asia/Shanghai
- Observed at: 2026-11-09 08:07–08:09 (Asia/Shanghai), captured from on-device screenshots (1080x2440)
- Component: chat answer rendering / task execution / session lifecycle
- Observed time: 08:09:45

## Version Information
- DigitalMate 0.1.9 (Android mobile client)

## Additional Information
- Likely the same backend restart that also produced the ClientConnectionResetError and the duplicated Q&A card.

## 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

For a single question, the same "提问 / 已回答" Q&A card is rendered three times in a row (each with a different user reply attached), e.g.:
```
「上下班」的距离还需要具体两地才能算。请告诉我：1) 你从哪儿出发…2) 到哪儿上班…3) 主要通勤方式…
```

## Steps to reproduce
1. In a weak-network or failure-retry situation, submit the same question (e.g. "上下班有多远").
2. Wait for the answer cards.
3. Observe the same card repeated three times.

## Expected result
- Deduplicate by message id and show the card only once.

## Actual result
- Three identical "提问/已回答" cards are shown.

## Possible cause (inferred, not code-verified)
- Front-end retry/polling appends the same rendered card without deduplication.

## Detailed Environment Information Description
- App: DigitalMate (package `com.jiuwen.digitalmate`), mobile client
- Platform: Android phone
- Timezone: Asia/Shanghai
- Observed at: 2026-11-09 08:07–08:09 (Asia/Shanghai), captured from on-device screenshots (1080x2440)
- Component: chat answer rendering / task execution / session lifecycle
- Observed time: 08:09:49

## Version Information
- DigitalMate 0.1.9 (Android mobile client)

- The duplicated card also re-shows the distance clarification template, so it overlaps with the memory/context issue.

| **11/16** | A08 ← A07 | Agent Service interaction owner。 |
| **11/17** | A09 ← A08/A31/A32 | Server Runtime owner，依赖生产者先合入再完成真实装配验收。 |

协调负责人为 **@Jianyu010 / 主会话**；执行责任沿用原 Issue 的 component owner。主会话下一次更新须为上述每条线登记实际执行负责人/会话、独立审阅者、已承诺可用容量和退出 ETA；尚未落实者写 UNKNOWN 并计入风险，不能将这些角色名称当作已分配资源。T2-a、T2-b 分别判断；A09 尚未整体验收不使已经按原范围完成的 A03/A05 回退为未交付。A09 若提前满足前置与门禁，可提前合入，不等 11/17。

#### #935 的范围与原 owner（F2）

#935 是现有独立产品 Bug，原 assignee 为 **@Evelynn-V**；本 Issue 不更改其指派、决策权、完整范围或 #737 的 103 分母。T1 要求的是相关现象在冻结基线/迁移路径上的归因和回归证据，以及修复迁移新增回归；**不要求 #935 整单关闭或实现其全部 Suggested fix direction**。

维护者已要求处理验收发现的实际 Bug，正常缺陷修复仍可由原 owner 与主会话协调后并行交付，包括在已有契约内修复被复现的错误分类。手动 merge/split/rename、Uncategorized 新兜底、标题策略或训练反馈等新增语义不由此计划自动批准，仍走实际产品/组件 owner 和适用变更控制。把新增产品建议另列不等于放过已复现的基础功能失败：具体门禁失败、迁移回归及阻断性问题必须保留并处置，不能因范围分离改写为 PASS。新修复合入后作为冻结基线的明确增量保留，不静默改旧断言或历史结果。

#### 连续双轮验收、容量与设备租约（F3）

沿用当前仓库 [ACCEPTANCE.md §7](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c19f1370542946bd67f87ded6ff010c1a3607afd/tests/e2e/workflow/ACCEPTANCE.md#L121) 和 [case-catalog.yaml 的 stablePasses](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c19f1370542946bd67f87ded6ff010c1a3607afd/tests/cases/case-catalog.yaml#L47)：适用分组要求**同版本、同构建、同复核条件连续两次完整通过**。目录中的 ready、单次 PASS、核心烟测或重复拷贝运行归档都不能替代稳定通过。

- **11/11 前：** Q04/Q10 QA coordinator 枚举实际 case/tier/group、每侧 A/B 要求、stablePasses、HAP/driver/assertion/构建/后端身份及前置；识别旧基线失败，不能把所有 Qxx 笼统标成同一双跑组。
- **11/14 前：** 用实际基线/已就绪组测量单轮耗时和准备/恢复开销，落实候选时段。租约协调负责人 **@Jianyu010 / 主会话**；执行由现有唯一 emulator/ADX 操作员承担（当前主会话 lane 为 `real_deployment_emulator_acceptance`），由 Q04/Q10 独立 QA coordinator 编排、独立 reviewer 验收。主会话须公布具名 owner、设备/账户、租约凭据范围、A/B 串行时段和替补安排；本计划**没有自动取得未来租约**。没有实际授权/排班则记 BLOCKED/UNKNOWN 并预警。
- **候选锁定必须在包括 A09 在内的全部受影响 T3 最终集成合入之后，内部目标为 11/17 18:00。** 锁定被验收候选和可比条件时，计算剩余容量：各适用完整组每侧所需两轮 + 构建/部署/ADX 隔离/切换/清理/独立审阅/失败重跑。独占设备按串行总工时计算，不能用总 agent 并发数抵消设备时间。若任一受影响 T3 项晚于锁点、准备超过下列专用时段，或包含上述开销的完整组无法装入各轮窗口及保留缓冲，立即重新预测并报告预计延期，不等到 11/22；不得锁定不含最终 T3 集成的旧候选并计入最终通过。
- **准备专用时段：11/18 00:00–12:00，用于构建/部署/ADX 隔离及身份核对，不计完整 PASS。第一轮完整运行窗口：11/18 12:00–11/19 11:59（24 小时）。第二轮完整运行窗口：11/19 12:00–11/20 23:59（36 小时）。** 这是容量安排目标，逐组实际租约时段须由上述 owner 确认；没有实际授权/排班和耗时证据则容量仍为 BLOCKED/UNKNOWN，不表示已预约或已确认可容纳。已更早满足真实前置和可比条件的组可提前双跑。两侧原要求和同条件约束均保留，其他只读/组件/文档任务继续并发。
- **11/21–11/22：** 保留修复、受影响完整组重新双跑及独立总验收容量，不作为默认第二轮窗口。任一次 FAIL/BLOCKED/INVALID、输入/条件变化或采样不完整按现有稳定规则中断连续计数；版本/构建/条件变更后，按新版本/构建和冻结条件为受影响完整组重定基，并重新取得连续两次完整通过，不能把旧组改标为新候选。冻结只约束验收输入，不要求全仓停止并发；合入新行为要明确受影响范围与所需重验。
- Q10 按组/每侧列出两次独立 run ID、版本/构建与条件、完整 case 数、结果及稳定性报告链接。未齐备、失败或历史差异处置单列，**不计为稳定通过**；原门禁要求未满足时不能以一次通过宣布 T4/T5 完成。

#### 主会话每次更新的必填内容

主会话每次对外进度更新都必须**直接更新正文顶部「总体里程碑与当前预测」**：刷新相关行、下个 milestone 的 ETA/达标判断、整体预测、主要风险、证据依据和时间。**正文为当前计划与状态的唯一总览；不得只更新滚动评论。** 评论用于保留已发生的验收、预测变化、blocker 和范围差异的审计历史，并链接回正文；如已有滚动状态评论，应同步摘要而不另立当前状态权威。一次工具调用不是一次进度更新。每次必须包含：

1. **下一个未完成 milestone、目标时间、预计完成时间和能否达标：ON_TRACK / AT_RISK / MISSED。** 预计时间应给具体日期/时间或有依据的范围；无法估计时标 UNKNOWN，并写清欠缺信息、负责人及取得时间，不能默认为按期。
2. **距下个 milestone 的剩余交付、关键路径、当轮验收增量和证据链接。** 分别报告已合入生产调用、已部署版本、客户端实际验收和按原范围关闭的任务；测试数量和草稿数量不能代替这些结果。
3. **延期风险、负责人、解除时间和应对动作。** 为最主要的 1–3 项写明影响、下一步和备用路径；明确哪些独立工作已转去并行，不能只写“仍在推进”。
4. **两周总目标的当前预测与信心。** 保留 11/22 目标，单独给出真实预计完成日；若偏离，要公开偏离天数和恢复措施，不能静默移动目标或减少原验收范围。
5. **可提前交付项。** 主动检查后续里程碑中已解锁的任务并提前实现、审阅和合入；说明真实的共享 owner/资源串行点，避免把日期窗口变成队列。

```text
更新时间（Asia/Shanghai）／实际 main 与候选：
下一个 milestone／目标时间：
预计完成时间（或 UNKNOWN + 缺失信息取得时间）：
能否达标：ON_TRACK | AT_RISK | MISSED
本次可核验交付及证据：
剩余关键路径与所需时间：
主要延期风险：原因／owner／解除 ETA／恢复动作
提前推进和合入的后续任务：
11/22 总目标：预计完成日／信心／偏离及应对
```

#### 压缩总工期的执行方式与预警

- 从第 1 天起并行运行生产集成、独立组件交付、部署/UI、回归/性能/治理；优先复用已审阅的准备包，减少远期无接口草稿和重复基础设施改动。
- 单项先做受影响验证；兼容变更进入协调的集成分支，对明确的整批候选构建/部署和 UI 验收，再通过正常流程合入。常规 UI 核心场景以几分钟为目标，扩展场景约十分钟；完整最终语料仍按 Q04–Q10 执行，不得用烟测替代。
- 明确外部权限、测试账户、G10 管理员执行和旧历史/回滚边界的实际 owner，尽早请求具体输入。共享凭据轮换由其所有者协调；不要公开凭据。
- 若 11/11 首个真实纵向切片未完成，或 11/14 的 T2-a / T2-b 未分别按上述范围退出，或 11/17 A09 原范围/双轮容量与租约仍未就绪，必须把两周总目标重新评为高风险并给出具体纠偏/新预测，不能继续显示绿色。
- 每个三天检查点都复核未来六天的剩余工作量和关键路径，及时重分配可并行能力；保留最后两天的修复/独立验收容量。若已知必做工作无法装入剩余时间，应立即报告延期，不等到最后一天。

#### 历史初始状态与仍适用的关闭条件

**初始状态：T1 未完成；两周总目标 AT_RISK（高风险），尚无有依据的最终完工预测。** 当前已知 Hosted 候选尚未完成实际部署和 unchanged-HAP 验收；ADX 隔离/历史兼容、构建资源和管理员执行项仍需归属明确。受控 CI 已有通过证据，普通路径失败/批准的限定接纳、实际 Windows ST、最终候选 source 和部署证据必须按各自作用域记录，不能合称全绿。主会话须在收到本 Issue 后的首次进度更新中以最新事实补全预测。

- [x] T0（11/07–11/09）首批生产基础与协作/验收工具按上方明确范围完成，12 个原始工作包的原生状态已核对。
- [ ] T1 按上述标准验收并回填。
- [ ] T2 按上述标准验收并回填。
- [ ] T3 按上述标准验收并回填。
- [ ] T4 按上述标准验收并回填。
- [ ] T5 / #737 / Q11 最终结论与证据闭环。
- [ ] 各 milestone 的目标、实际时间、风险变化及最终差异保留，可追溯至原任务。

本 Issue 不因建立计划、到达目标日期或部分里程碑完成而关闭。若需要延期，保持开放并更新预测；最终功能、数据、兼容性、性能或强制门禁未通过时不得声称两周目标完成。

issue:972.body:
### 🚀 Background Description
需要可靠地观察用户从手机提交云端请求到首文本和终态的体验，并将端侧观测与云侧指标区分。已有草稿 PR #555 覆盖部分采集与上报，但尚未完成部署和端到端验证，本 issue 跟踪剩余工作，避免重复实现。

### Design Ideas
核对并复用 #555：定义提交、端侧首个有效文本、收到终态和展示完成事件，分别计算提交到首文本、终态和展示完成耗时，使用端侧同一单调时钟；区分失败、取消、超时、重试，保留覆盖率及样本量。端侧观测与生产网关数据隔离，最小化数据、遵循性能记录授权。

### Test Design and Test Plan
用可控时钟验证各边界和重试、无文本、断线、失败及取消；真机验证从采集、受控接收、聚合到看板的链路，记录部署版本、覆盖率和结果；确认不上传对话内容及凭据。缺失值不补零。

issue:973.body:
### 🚀 Background Description
需要定位端侧到云侧请求上行和云侧到端侧响应下行耗时。现有端侧发送 API 耗时或 wire_send 累计时间不等于网络单程耗时；跨设备时钟未经校准无法可靠相减。与 #555 的端侧采集互补。

### Design Ideas
定义每次发送尝试 D1、对应网关受理 G0，以及同一首文本 chunk 的网关发送 G1、端侧接收 D2；探索可靠的 trace、attempt、chunk 标识和时钟同步误差上界。上行 G0−D1、下行 D2−G1 仅在配对和精度满足要求时展示，说明其含协议缓冲及解析开销；不可用时展示缺失原因，不使用负值截零或将剩余耗时冒充单程。终态 recv 须先确认终态消息对应关系。

### Test Design and Test Plan
模拟时钟偏移、延迟、重试、丢包和乱序，验证匹配和误差阈值；真机与网关核对相同事件、覆盖率和分布。验证未同步、缺少配对与负值均不可用，记录数据保护和性能开销。

issue:974.body:
### 🚀 Background Description
现网已有云侧首吐字、答案首吐字、ReAct、工具调用、请求耗时和模型指标，需要核对其部署覆盖及端云关联，避免将首吐字、ReAct 和模型 TTFT 混淆。

### Design Ideas
核验云侧网关受理至首个文本 chunk、首答案 chunk、流结束的埋点，以及服务端适配器 tool_call 到对应 tool_result 的耗时。按请求或工具调用分别聚合均值、P50、P95、样本数、失败数和覆盖情况；关联业务请求、模型调用与重试，避免不同粒度混算。保留现网已有实现，修补缺口并与看板维护方协调。

### Test Design and Test Plan
用可控事件覆盖无文本、首文本即答案、多工具并行、工具失败及重试；按原始记录复算单次值和聚合分位，验证部署环境缺样本时显示空值，并核对旧版日志截断导致的覆盖不足。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem
发送一个问题后，在助手生成答案的过程中中止本次生成（界面出现「已停止本次生成，可继续提问」），随后很快发送「继续」，期望接着刚被中止的那条回答继续生成或补全；但助手无法关联最近一次被中止的回答，回复「我这边暂时没有找到可以"继续"的任务记录——这个对话里还没有之前的工作内容，工作区和输出目录也都是空的。请告诉我你想继续哪件事，或者直接把任务…」，把刚刚中止的回答当成了不存在的内容。

截图场景：用户先问「最近黄仁勋最热的"八卦"是一桩婚外情风波。这次风波对英伟达股价有什么影响？帮我查一下」，在生成过程中停止，界面显示「已停止本次生成，可继续提问」，用户随即发送「继续」，助手却提示找不到可继续的任务记录。

### 复现步骤
1. 发送一个问题（如「这次风波对英伟达股价有什么影响？帮我查一下」），触发一段较长的答案生成。
2. 在生成过程中中止本次生成，界面出现「已停止本次生成，可继续提问」。
3. 很快发送「继续」。
4. 观察助手的回复。

### 期望行为
- 「继续」应关联并接续最近一次被中止的回答，从中断处继续生成或补全，而不是要求用户重新描述。
- 被中止的那条回答应被保留为可继续的上下文，不应丢失或被判定为「无任务记录」。

### 实际行为
- 助手回复「我这边暂时没有找到可以"继续"的任务记录——这个对话里还没有之前的工作内容，工作区和输出目录也都是空的。请告诉我你想继续哪件事……」。
- 无法识别「继续」指向的是刚被中止的那条回答，最近一次中止的生成上下文丢失。

### Detailed Environment Information Description
- 应用：DigitalMate / BeeBou（包名 com.jiuwen.digitalmate）
- 平台：鸿蒙手机（HarmonyOS 7.0）
- 屏幕分辨率：1080 × 2406
- 界面语言：简体中文
- 时间：2026-11-09 18:35（Asia/Shanghai）

### Version Information
- App 版本：0.1.9
- 系统版本：鸿蒙 7.0（HarmonyOS 7.0）

### 可能的改进方向
- 中止生成时保留该轮已生成内容与任务上下文，作为可「继续」的草稿。
- 让「继续」这类指代默认绑定最近一次被中止的回复，而不是判定为无任务记录。
- 中止操作不应清空当前轮次的任务/工作区状态；恢复时应能读取中断前的内容。
- 增加「中止后立即继续」的回归用例。

### 优先级
中高 —— 打断后无法续接，用户需重新提问，影响多轮连续性与可用性

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem
助手回答时，「过程气泡（展示正在做什么，如正在编辑文件、正在等待校验等）」与「结果气泡（最终答复）」在视觉上缺乏明显区分，很容易把过程信息当成结果信息来理解。

截图场景（07:02）：顶部只有一个很小的「BeeBou 正在编辑文件：…」过程提示；随后出现一条灰色气泡「Template check is still running. Let me wait for it to complete and check the conclusion.」——这其实是过程信息（还在等模板校验），却用了与最终答复几乎一样的灰色气泡样式，用户很容易误以为这就是结果；直到后面「你好！我是 DigitalMate，你的个人 AI 助手…」才是真正的结果气泡。过程信息与结果信息外观几乎一致，难以分辨。

此外，过程信息应该如何展示也需要再讨论：展示哪些内容、以什么样式/位置呈现、是否折叠、是否放到独立的「过程/思考」区域等，都还需要进一步确认。

### 复现步骤
1. 发送一个会触发多步工具调用/较长处理的任务（如提 issue、查资料）。
2. 在助手处理过程中观察：顶部出现「正在编辑文件：…」之类的过程提示。
3. 观察处理过程中出现的「Template check is still running…」这类陈述，它显示为与最终答复相同的灰色气泡。
4. 对比随后出现的最终答复气泡，二者样式几乎无差异。

### 期望行为
- 过程气泡与结果气泡应有明确的视觉区分（如颜色、位置、图标、「处理中/已完成」标签、缩进或不同容器），让用户一眼能分辨「这是过程」还是「这是结果」。
- 过程信息集中展示在独立的「过程/思考」区域（可折叠），不与最终答复混排在同一视觉样式里。
- 过程信息不应被误当作最终答案；结果气泡应更突出、更易识别。
- 过程信息展示的具体方案（展示内容、样式、折叠与交互等）需要进一步讨论确认。

### 实际行为
- 过程信息（如「Template check is still running. Let me wait for it to complete and check the conclusion.」）与结果答复使用几乎相同的灰色气泡样式，缺少区分。
- 用户容易把过程信息误认为结果信息，往往需要读完整段才能判断哪一条才是最终答复。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 屏幕分辨率：1080 × 2406

### 可能的改进方向
- 为过程气泡与结果气泡设计不同样式：过程用浅色/描边/小字号/带「处理中」标识，结果用主样式并突出显示。
- 把过程信息收进可折叠的「过程/思考」区域，默认展示一行摘要，展开查看细节。
- 过程信息与最终答复分区展示，避免在同一气泡流里混排。
- 过程信息展示的内容粒度、样式、折叠与交互方案需要与产品一起再讨论确认。

### Checklist

- [x] 该问题在最新版本中仍存在
- [x] 已提供环境信息、复现步骤与截图

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem
「实时活动」页面的「最近话题」列表用状态标签区分各话题进度，但「等待回复」这一状态把两种完全不同的情况混在了一起，容易误导用户：

1. 回答已经完成，只是等用户继续发问（对话处于空闲、本轮已结束）；
2. 回答过程中弹出了需求收集卡，正在等用户输入补充信息（真正卡在等用户提供信息）。

截图（07:12）里，多条话题都标为「等待回复」，例如「用户先要求识别并起草『会话关联失效』issue…」「用户关注黄仁勋近期八卦…」「助手确认理解任务说明与角色设定，等待用户提供具体任务」，其中有些其实回答已经完成、只是在等用户继续发问，却被归为「等待回复」，让人误以为助手还在等用户回复、任务尚未完成。

第一种情况（回答完成、等待用户继续发问）不应该归到「等待回复」类型；只有第二种（确实在等用户补充信息/输入）才应算「等待回复 / 等待输入」。

### 复现步骤
1. 让助手完成一个完整回答（不再有待办动作）。
2. 打开「实时活动」页查看「最近话题」。
3. 可以看到已完成的对话被标为「等待回复」。
4. 再对比一条确实弹出需求收集卡、在等用户补充信息的话题，两者状态标签没有区分。

### 期望行为
- 明确区分两种状态：
  - 回答完成、等待用户继续发问：不应显示为「等待回复」，可显示为「已完成 / 查看对话」等，不提示仍在等待。
  - 回答中发出需求收集卡、等待用户补充信息：才使用「等待回复 / 等待输入」这类状态。
- 「等待回复」应只表示助手确实在等用户提供信息/输入，而不是回答结束后的空闲状态。
- 状态判定逻辑应基于当前轮次是否真正阻塞在用户输入上。

### 实际行为
- 「等待回复」同时覆盖「回答已完成、空闲等用户再问」与「需求收集卡等待用户补充信息」两种不同情况。
- 已完成回答的话题也被标为「等待回复」，用户容易误以为任务还没结束、助手还在等自己回复。

### Detailed Environment Information Description
- 应用：DigitalMate / BeeBou（包名 com.jiuwen.digitalmate）
- 平台：鸿蒙手机（HarmonyOS 7.0）
- 屏幕分辨率：1080 × 2406
- 界面语言：简体中文
- 时间：2026-11-09 19:12（Asia/Shanghai）

### Version Information
- App 版本：0.1.9
- 系统版本：鸿蒙 7.0（HarmonyOS 7.0）

### 可能的改进方向
- 为「实时活动」话题状态增加区分：如「已完成 / 查看对话」「等待输入（需求收集卡）」「处理中」等，而不是统一「等待回复」。
- 回答完成、本轮结束时不要标「等待回复」，改用完成类状态。
- 仅在真正弹出需求收集卡、等待用户补充信息时使用「等待回复 / 等待输入」。
- 状态判定基于当前轮次是否阻塞在用户输入上。

### 优先级
中 —— 状态标签误导用户对任务进度与「是否需要回复」的判断，影响可用性但不阻塞核心功能

issue:999.body:
### Background and Goal Description

Memory 让 DM 在换了会话以后，还能查到用户说过什么，以及获准读取的邮件、日历等信息。

1. **DM 启用插件。** DM 启动时装配 Memory 的 Ingestion 和 Retrieval 接口。首版建议 Ingestor 用进程内的异步处理流。需要隔离时可以把同一处理流放进子进程，调用方仍用相同接口。
2. **每个获准事件触发一次摄取。** DM 保存会话消息或结果，或连接层确认 App 数据变化后，把事件交给 Ingestion。后台完成分类、裁定如何更新记忆，以及哪些结果应进入可读的 surface。会话可以先返回。
3. **需要时再查。** 后续会话由 DM 按需查询 Memory Provider。记忆发布后，常驻的 Commander 从已授权的变更通道续读，自己决定何时检查有没有值得做的事。来源更新、删除或撤权时，DM 先停止使用旧证据，随后刷新记忆和候选。

例如，用户在会话 A 说「周会前帮我整理未决项」，随后 Gmail 收到一封写着「预算尚未确认」的邮件。Ingestor 分别记录用户的要求和邮件证据。用户换到会话 B 问「还有什么没定」，DM 就能查到预算这一项，并给出邮件出处。

DM 自行实现这套记忆逻辑，沿用 PPMA 中可验证的溯源、版本化和跨 App 对象身份思路。PPMA 和 Linkie 可独立演进。

### Proposed Solution

#### 周会示例时序图

图中是目标流程。Commander 启动后自己观察记忆变更和时间，识别值得行动的情况。用户确认后，DM 才提交任务。

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as 用户／DM UI
    participant S as 会话与 App 来源
    participant H as DM 宿主
    participant M as Memory／Ingestor
    participant C as Proactivity／Commander
    participant A as Router／Session Manager
    participant R as Agent Service
    Note over H,C: DM 按配置启用插件并装配通道
    H->>C: 启动常驻 Commander，提供受限接口
    C->>H: 订阅 Memory 变更，从持久游标续读
    U->>S: 会话 A 交代「周会前整理未决项」
    S->>H: Session Store 持久保存后发出会话事件
    S->>H: 连接层交付已核实的 Gmail 和 Calendar 事件
    H->>M: 经 Memory 事件处理器交付上述来源事件
    M-->>H: 回执确认已持久接收
    Note over M: 异步分类、裁定与发布，推进 surface revision
    M-->>H: 发布带 revision 的 surface 变更
    H-->>C: 经订阅通道交付变更事实
    C->>H: 按引用读取会议时间和用户要求
    H-->>C: 经 Memory Provider 返回当前依据
    C->>C: 更新周会观察条件并保存会前检查时间
    alt 会前窗口内有相关证据变化
        C->>C: 评估该周会是否值得行动
    else 到了自己设定的会前检查时间
        C->>C: 从时钟等待恢复并评估
    end
    C->>H: 请求当前有效证据
    H->>M: 通过 Memory Provider 查询
    M-->>H: 返回会话要求、预算和会议时间
    H-->>C: 返回 surface revision 和有效证据版本
    C->>C: 确认预算仍未决，保存候选
    C-->>H: 发布候选「整理一页会前清单」
    H-->>U: 展示候选
    U->>H: 点开始，确认这个候选版本
    H->>A: 宿主提交任务、证据版本、提交 ID 和事项键
    Note over A: Router 选 Session，Store 复核证据并按事项键去重
    A-->>H: 返回接纳回执及 Run ID
    A->>R: Agent Service 接管已接纳的 Run
    R-->>H: 发布进度，提交清单草稿后报告完成
    H-->>U: Activity 显示进度和结果
```

#### 最终架构与接入点

Memory 包向宿主声明**能力提供者和事件处理器**。下表描述拟定的插件声明及其调用方向，具体注册类型、签名和绑定格式由对应宿主负责人定稿。

| 插件声明 | 宿主何时调用 | 插件返回或提交什么 |
|---|---|---|
| **Retrieval** | Session 绑定读取接口的版本。模型显式检索时走 HostAPI 和 Plugin Gateway。获准的后台消费者通过宿主提供的接口查询和续读。 | 返回当前可读的 surface、`surface_rev`、条目版本及证据引用。已提交的变更按游标续读，供 Commander 更新自己的观察状态。 |
| **归档恢复贡献** | Agent Service 在 `archive_restored` 调用已绑定的 Memory hook，传入已验证的 Session 范围和读取预算。 | 返回有限的上下文及证据引用，由宿主决定纳入本轮的内容。普通回合是否自动 recall、在哪个阶段 recall，留给 HostAPI owner 定稿。 |
| **Ingestion** | Session 生命周期在消息／结果持久提交后交付受限事件，回合结果接 `turn_committed`。连接层交付已核实的对象变化。纠正、删除等 Memory 命令也由同一写入所有者处理。 | 返回持久接收回执。后台处理完成后登记发布结果或无变更结果。 |

装配时，Registry 解析精确版本及声明的依赖，Profile 决定是否启用。Session 绑定读取和恢复接口的版本。**每个工作区只有一个 Memory 写入所有者**，不同读取版本通过兼容接口访问同一写入域。首版建议用有界的进程内异步处理流，依靠持久接收记录恢复未完成事件。子进程作为部署选项，沿用相同的事件、回执和发布语义。后台提取使用宿主授予的身份、数据权限和模型预算。 [注册与绑定 ADR](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/adr/0003-registration-and-binding.md) · [V3.1 生命周期与接入点](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/visions/README.md)

V3.1 的 Registry 参考实现已有精确版本的 `core`、`model`、`tool`、`skill` 装配。Memory 的工具部分可沿用 Provider 模式。恢复 hook 由 M22 跟进，持久来源事件的订阅、接收回执和重放仍需宿主契约。M22／M38 计划中的目标目录为 `plugins/memory/`。 [Registry 参考实现](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/registry/README.md) · [M22 #791](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/791) · [M38 #810](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/810)

#### 摄取、读取与失效

1. **提交来源事件。** DM 先提交 Session 消息或结果，再交付事件。连接层核实账号和对象状态后交付同形事件。来源接口携带服务端解析的 `scope`、生产者命名空间内的 `event_id`、`source_key`、对象版本 `source_rev`、三方授权代次 `grant_epoch`、操作和补录标志。更新携带可按版本读取的内容引用。Webhook 只有变更提示且版本不可比较时，由连接层核实当前快照再登记版本。
2. **分类、裁定、发布。** Categorization 识别事件中的承诺、状态等记录及其证据。Jurisdiction 结合当前 surface，裁定可以新增、更新或撤下哪条记录，以及写入哪个范围。Promotion 决定哪些结果可以进入可读 surface，并生成变更。三步是逻辑阶段，可合并实现。同一事件和内容重放时恢复原回执及已提交结果，内容冲突显式失败。中断可以重试，成功发布只发生一次。无变更的处理结果也记录。历史补录可建立记忆，单独补录保持静默。
3. **按需读取。** `ModelCall` 与 `AgentCall` 都可使用合格的记忆。Session Store 按自己的上下文版本推进，追加新消息时已有消息的证据版本仍有效。同一会话的下一轮直接读已提交历史，跨 Session 可见性从 Memory 发布开始。普通 recall 可以按预算超时降级，显式引用的证据失效时返回可区分的错误。「记住」和「忘掉」以 Provider 的操作回执为准。
4. **失效优先于重算。** 来源更新使旧对象版本失效，删除留下删除标记，撤权关闭整代连接授权。有效版本提交后，随后开始的读取和任务接纳都须排除旧证据。派生记忆、索引和候选投影随后清理。迟到的提取结果无法恢复旧版本。合并记忆若仍有独立依据，可从剩余证据重新生成。会话转述的 App 内容保留原始依赖。用户亲自陈述的独立承诺仍按自身权限可读。

#### Surface revision 与防重

Surface 是某个作用域当前可读的记忆视图。每次提交改变内容、证据或可见性时，推进该 surface 的 `surface_rev`。回放和无变更结果保持原 revision。发布后，读取只能看到已提交的版本，变更记录可以续读。Retrieval 同时返回实际使用的 `memory_id + memory_rev` 和 `source_refs`。

Commander 按游标追变更，用 `surface_rev` 识别已观察过的版本。它记录候选实际依赖的条目和来源版本。整个 surface 推进后，可以只复核那些依赖。另一条无关记忆的变化无需撤回周会候选。某个事项是否已经开过 Run 由 DM 接纳记录判断。 [Proactivity 的接纳幂等](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/998)

**共同的提交边界。** 目前提议由 DM Store 维护小型有效版本索引，供接纳事务校验证据。来源所有者和 Memory Provider 通过公开接口推进各自版本。DM 撤权以有效状态提交为准，三方变化从 DM 核实并登记后生效。Ingestor 先持久化可恢复的提取结果，再以当前来源和所读版本为条件发布。发布点一次确定事件结果、可见 revision 和变更记录。旧结果与当前证据冲突时重新判断。Store 在写接纳回执的同一事务里校验证据和事项身份。具体存储与发布事务仍由 Memory、Store 和 Agent Service 定稿。 [V3.1 Store 接纳契约](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27cd2630f3ebd77c8cf49f9353796408872e346/docs/specs/session-store-admission.md)

#### 当前重构阶段的交付方式

当前主线经 `server_engine.engine_cli` 启动。首页的 Session Affinity 已运行在 `dm_sessions` 与现有 Bridge 上。当前 Memory 由 `EngineMemory` 的目录与证据链、兼容 `MemoryStore` 和 `FactKeeper/MemoryStep` 等路径共同提供。可用现有 `memory.read`／`memory.search` 刻画权限和检索行为，用 `FactKeeper.after_run` 刻画回合后触发。可重放的事件交付需要单独证明。目标 `server/plugin_gateway/` 和 `plugins/memory/` 在这份主线基线上尚未落地。 [当前生产边界和 Memory 归属](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27cd2630f3ebd77c8cf49f9353796408872e346/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/architecture-gate.md) · [现有 Memory 读取入口](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27cd2630f3ebd77c8cf49f9353796408872e346/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_service.py#L2712) · [A32 #758](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/758)

| 阶段 | 开发与验证范围 |
|---|---|
| **现在** | 由测试装配器用 DM Session 样本及 Gmail／Calendar 回放驱动异步 Ingestion。以真实临时存储验证 surface revision、回执、重放和失效。先以影子读评估质量，生产记忆写入仍由现有所有者承担。 |
| **迁移过渡** | 若现有所有者能提供已发布、可重放的输入接口，可在当前入口装配薄适配器。记录调用方、唯一写入方、替换条件和迁移 owner。以此接入取决于实际接口和权限，夹具验证可先行。真实 App 由 M43／M44 的连接所有者补齐后台订阅或增量同步及撤权。 |
| **目标切换** | 等 A32、M22／M38 的实际消费者接通后，将支持的记忆路径统一委派给新 Provider。盘点现存数据、引用和读者，验证格式与历史读取。在切换写入权之前阻止旧写入方继续提交。回退按兼容范围恢复受支持入口，保留已提交记录与失效状态。 |

[并行开发与临时适配器规则](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27cd2630f3ebd77c8cf49f9353796408872e346/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md) · [M43 #833](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/833) · [M44 #834](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/834)

#### 开发前需要厘清的核心细节

| 负责方 | 需要做出的决定 |
|---|---|
| **Session Store／连接层／Memory** | 定首版事件种类、提交点、生产者幂等键、游标和保留窗口。明确用户消息何时可摄取、哪些完成结果可作为证据，以及取消、清空会话、编辑和权限变化如何产生失效。历史事件若超出保留窗口，明确何时要重新同步。 |
| **Memory／连接层／产品** | 定每类内容的访问、保留和删除范围，尤其是私人会话、工作区共享、三方引用、模型可见内容及撤权后的索引与缓存清理。确定连接重新授权时如何切换代次。 |
| **Memory／Store／Agent Service** | 定有效版本索引的归属和提交顺序。明确如何恢复已持久化但未发布的记忆，如何保证删除／撤权与接纳的竞争结果可解释，以及条件接纳暂不可用时的退化行为。 |
| **Memory／Registry／HostAPI** | 定 Provider、恢复 hook 和事件处理器分别用哪个扩展类型注册，谁装配与调用，哪些版本随 Session 绑定。明确启用配置、可选 recall 超时与已绑定版本缺失各如何表现。 |
| **Memory／Runtime／部署** | 定异步处理流的恢复、容量和隔离需求。如果选择子进程，再定 IPC 和就绪。确定 Provider 版本与存储格式的兼容范围，以及现有 MemoryStore／EngineMemory 的读者迁移和唯一写入切换。 |
| **Memory／Proactivity** | 定 Commander 主动订阅或续读的通道、最小查询、证据引用与变更语义。明确后台消费者可见的数据范围、补录静默及游标失效时如何重新同步。 |

### Involved Public APIs

Memory 暴露 Ingestion 和 Retrieval。需要定稿的是持久接收与恢复语义、surface revision 和条目版本、可续读的变更通道，以及发布时的版本比较。首版建议使用进程内异步流，子进程沿用同一契约。

### Test Verification

以下为计划验收。

Session A 记录「周会前整理未决事项」。Calendar 回放给出会议时间，Gmail 邮件给出预算和报价两项。Session B 能引用三条来源。邮件更新为「报价已完成」后，旧记忆立即失去读取资格，新版本只保留预算。删除邮件并重放旧事件时，邮件事实仍不可读，独立的用户承诺和日历信息保留。撤销 Gmail 授权则覆盖同一代的全部 Gmail 证据。

让旧提取晚于来源更新完成，让写入后丢失回执，再让 Commander 停止消费变更。分别观察旧结果无法发布、同一事件重放只得到原结果和 revision，以及旧候选被当前证据拒绝。再验证无变更事件保持原 revision。在接纳与撤权的事务边界强制两种提交顺序，以 Store 回执和可见内容验收。

插件装配验收用同一宿主分别启用和关闭 Memory，验证新 Session 的绑定与事件派发随 Profile 变化。再切换 Provider 版本，验证旧 Session 解析原绑定或报告该版本缺失，同一来源的摄取写入仍只经过一个所有者。

### Additional Supplementary Information

配套提案见 [Proactivity RFC](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/998)。

本提案沿用既有后端重构方向，并和 V3.1 迁移任务协调。 [后端模块化重构 #505](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/505) · [V3.1 迁移 #737](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737)

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents

## Summary

Group the DigitalMate product-center artifacts by the authoritative session-affinity topic instead of showing one flat list. The artifact center is a read-only projection: `DigitalMateConversation.artifactTopicAssignments()` maps `taskId -> conversationId -> conversation title` from the existing `session_proximity` snapshot, walks `parent_task_id` for child artifacts, and degrades missing or cyclic parents to 未归类. Display identity is always the ID-based key, so retitling a conversation changes only the label.

`ArtifactPresentation.artifactTopicGroups()` is a pure, unit-tested function: same-topic tasks merge, same-title conversations stay separate, same-name files are not deduped, files sort by generation time with a stable fallback, and search matches the topic title (all files) or individual file names (only matches). The page renders expandable topic rows with count and latest time, preserves loading/retry/empty/no-result states, and reuses the existing preview/open/download/delete actions. No second artifact write path, no new download, and no change to session-affinity classification or routing.

Closes #1048

## Validation

### Unit tests

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-topics.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-versions.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-center-delete.test.mjs` on head `487f8fe9` (DevEco bundled Node v24.14.1): 39/39 pass (19 new tests).
- Full Node suite (`tests/unit/*.test.mjs`, `tests/unit/ascf-device/*.test.mjs`, `tests/e2e/workflow/workflow.test.mjs`) was run earlier on this branch: 2170 tests, 2117 pass, 45 fail. All 45 are environment-only: missing `typescript`/`playwright`/`ws` (no `node_modules` in either checkout) and a Windows temp-copy `EIO`; the same `Cannot find module 'typescript'` failure reproduces on the untouched primary checkout. Not re-run for the screenshot-only commit `487f8fe9`.

### HarmonyOS emulator verification

Built, installed and exercised the real artifact center on a DevEco emulator; the evidence below comes from the app UI, not from unit tests.

- Source: branch head `487f8fe9` (feature commit `7e46943e`).
- Build: `hvigorw.bat --mode module -p module=entry@default -p product=default -p buildMode=debug assembleHap --no-daemon` with DevEco Studio 26.0's bundled hvigor 6.26.8, `DEVECO_SDK_HOME` = bundled SDK, `JAVA_HOME` = bundled JBR.
- Device: DevEco emulator `Mate 90 Pro`, HarmonyOS 6.0.0.130(SP7DEVC00E130R4P11), API 22. Installed app `com.jiuwen.digitalmate` 0.1.0 (versionCode 10013, a local build-only bump to allow the install; not part of this PR).
- Signing/login: the HAP was signed with local debug material, whose certificate is not registered with AGC, so Huawei account login fails with 华为账号参数无效. Verification therefore used phone-number login.

Confirmed on device:

1. Entry: BeeBou avatar → AgentDetails → 产物中心 tab, search box `搜索话题或文件名`.
2. Two PPTs generated in one conversation merge into a single topic row showing `2 个产物 · 11/10 15:22`, and the two same-named `微服务架构核心组件.pptx` rows (15:22, 15:19) are both listed — same-name artifacts are not deduped.
3. A different conversation stays a separate group with `1 个产物`.
4. Collapse/expand is per topic: the two-file topic collapses while the other topic keeps its own state; the count and latest time stay on the header.
5. Search by topic-title token shows that topic and all of its files; search by file-name token shows only matching files and keeps the topic heading; no match shows 没有匹配的产物.
6. A collapsed topic is expanded automatically when the search matches inside it.
7. Preview opens, download saves through the system dialog, and the downloaded PPTX renders its two pages — the existing open/download path is unaffected.

Screenshots (also committed under `.github/issue-assets/1048/`):

Topic groups with independent collapse state:

![产物中心：两个话题分组与独立折叠状态](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_artifact-topic-groups.jpg)

Two same-named artifacts merged into one topic from two tasks of one conversation, next to a separate conversation:

![同一会话两次生成合并为一个话题，同名文件各自保留](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_same-name-artifacts.jpg)

Collapsing the two-file topic hides its files and keeps the header count/time:

![折叠两文件话题](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_topic-collapsed.jpg)

Search by topic title:

![搜索话题标题](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_search-topic-title.jpg)

Search by file name:

![搜索文件名](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_search-file-name.jpg)

Search expands a collapsed topic that contains a match:

![搜索时自动展开命中话题](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_search-expands-collapsed-topic.jpg)

No match state:

![没有匹配的产物](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_search-no-result.jpg)

Artifact actions menu:

![产物操作菜单](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_artifact-actions-menu.jpg)

Preview page opened from the topic row:

![打开产物预览](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_artifact-preview.jpg)

After download, the PPTX renders its two pages in the preview:

![下载后预览渲染](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_artifact-downloaded.jpg)

Not exercised on device: the 未归类 group (needs abnormal backend data), two conversations with identical titles (covered by unit tests only), artifact delete/restore, and delayed-affinity re-projection timing. The package was installed over an app signed with a different certificate, so the emulator app data was wiped during setup; all artifacts in the screenshots were generated during this verification.

## Version history (blocked server dependency)

- Client keeps only the last receipt per `(taskId, path)` (`DigitalMateConversation.ets:1100-1106`).
- Server drops old receipts for a rewritten path (`engine_service.py:3837-3840`), and `artifact.read` verifies the current file hash against the receipt (`engine_attachments.py:288-296`), so an overwritten old version fails with "This file changed since the task finished".
- Cross-task versions are separate artifacts and stay separately visible and deletable. Same-task overwritten history is intentionally not shown or faked. Independently reading historical versions needs a server-side versioned read; that acceptance item remains incomplete.

## Migration record

- Baseline: `origin/main` `c6845d4b` after rebasing the branch (earlier base `4ed211e0`).
- Authoritative writer: session proximity remains the sole owner of conversation identity and titles; this PR adds only a read-only projection. Legacy `topic_id`/`thread_id` data keeps a stable fallback key. No server or persistence changes.

pr:1026.body:
## 背景

bot（`agent-CI-Infra-bot`）的检视打标原先是通用规则：按 `type/*`、`priority/*`、`area/*` 这类斜杠轴选标签，并把 `priority/medium` 当默认。这与本仓库实际标签体系不匹配——这里是 `priority:P0/P1/P2`、`client`/`backend`/`hybrid`、`source:*`、`channel:*`。结果是模型选出的名字大多落在 `repository_labels` 之外，被控制面静默丢弃，等于不分类。

## 本 PR 做了什么

- 新增 `.bot/rules/labels.md`。这是 bot 文档规定的仓库级规则路径（`docs/rules.md`），整份覆盖内置 `labels.md`，每次检视都会注入。
- 规则内容对齐 #996 的 `.agents/skills/digitalmate-issue-triage`：只处理未指派且类型为 bug / UX / Experience feedback 的 Issue；四个维度（技术范围、优先级、source、channel）各最多一个值；优先级必须恰好一个 P0/P1/P2；只用现有标签，不新建、不改名；不覆盖人工已给的维度。
- 保留首行 `review_label: bot-reviewed`，检视标签行为不变。
- 全部标签名已对照仓库线上 43 个标签校验，无自造名称。

## 与 #996 的关系

#996 的 skill 已经在 main 上，bot 会把 `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` 作为按需 skill 索引（`docs/rules.md`）。但 skill 是按需读的，而 `labels.md` 是每个任务都注入的规则层。两份配合：本文件负责“每次检视必须怎么选标签”，skill 负责“分诊细节和责任田”。

## 生效方式

规则只从默认分支读（PR 内的改动不影响当次任务）。合入 `main` 后，下一次 Issue 检视即按新规则打标。注意：本 PR 改了 `.bot/`，bot 检视这个 PR 时会在总结里提示“改变了 bot 行为，需要人决定”，这是预期行为。

## 范围影响

feature / documentation / RFC / Competition feedback 等类型不再添加分类标签，只保留 `bot-reviewed`；这与 #996 skill 的 issueScope 一致。如果希望 feature 也自动分类，需要在后续 PR 里放宽本文件的处理范围。

pr:1033.body:
## Summary

Implements the approved scope of `docs/plans/session-artifact-grouping-proposal.md`:

- The server keeps prior artifact receipts for the same task + path, stamps each receipt with its delivery time, and serves a published receipt's immutable snapshot when the deliverable path now points at a later version.
- The DigitalMate client projects a version chain (`artifactVersions`) and a task → conversation owner map (`artifactOwners`), registers history versions in a separate file catalog, and groups the artifact center ("产物中心") by session-affinity conversation. Expanding a topic lists each readable version with a "第 i/n 版" label; preview/open/download/delete are reused.
- Chat cards are unchanged: `artifacts()` still returns only the latest active receipt per task + path. Delete stays local-hide only; no server delete contract was added.

Design and limits: `docs/archive/client/artifact-version-history.md` (moved with main's docs archive).

## Server

- `artifact_versions.py`: append-merge receipts, dedupe by receipt id, keep the existing 100-per-task cap.
- `engine_service.py` / `server.py`: use the append merge and add `created_at` from the ledger `applied_at`; wire the snapshot store into the attachments reader.
- `engine_attachments.py`: for a envelope whose path was overwritten, read the receipt's snapshot from `SnapshotStore` after validating receipt, path and SHA-256. Missing or mismatched content fails explicitly with "This version is unavailable"; the current file is never returned as an old version.
- `workswarm_artifacts.py`: byte quota counts retained ids, while the file-count quota stays per path.

## Client

- `cloud-adapter`: `DigitalMateArtifactVersionView` / `DigitalMateArtifactOwner`, `artifactVersions()` and `artifactOwners()` (parent-chain lookup with cycle guard, room-scoped keys, "未归类" fallback).
- `file-service`: optional `versionIndex` / `versionCount` on remote/view/record.
- `entry`: history catalog in `DigitalMateArtifactFiles` (`syncHistory`, `currentHistoryFiles`, `artifactCenterContext`), topic rendering in `DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`, and per-file catalog resolution so chat cards and artifact-center rows each read their own catalog.

## Tests run

```text
node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-session-grouping.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-center-grouping.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-versions.test.mjs \
```

pr:1039.body: ## Problem Fixes #971. In a later turn or a new conversation, the agent answers "no repository is connected" (or "I can't create issues") even though `gh issue create` already worked in this workspace. The route never became durable: - `MemoryStep` stores only facts quoted from the person's message, so the agent's own sentence ("the sandbox `gh` can create issues here") is never stored. That is deliberate: storing model claims would make a hallucination or a prompt injection durable. - `EditLearner` stores procedural lessons only from user edits, not from successful runs. - Recall is lexical and window-bound, and the GitHub connector inventory has read/comment/prefilled-form operations only, so nothing in the brief said the shell route exists. ## Change Record a route only from a successful tool receipt, and keep it in every brief: - **`server_engine/engine_brief.py`** now holds the capability registry, next to the brief it feeds (so #971 needs no new production module and no ownership-policy change): - `CapabilityRegistry.observe_tool_result` records `github.issue.create` from a successful shell result (`bash`, `Bash`, `shell`, `exec_command`, `commandExecution`, ...). A record needs the create at a command position *and* the issue URL `gh` prints; a grep, echo, comment line or create without a URL is not proof. - A failed receipt marks the record `stale` only when the environment's answer (the receipt's `Command:` echo is stripped) says sign-in or the executable is gone; a repository-scoped denial stales only that repository. A rejected title or body keeps the route. - `brief` renders a short `[capabilities]` section for records that are available and not older than 30 days. A route with no successful receipt is never listed, and background (ambient) tasks get no route to write. - **`server.py`** feeds every `tool_result` frame to the registry, the same frames the activity and breaker paths already read. - **`engine_service.py`** initializes the registry; `assemble_brief` injects the section through the existing `for_agents` gate. - **`ROUTING_NOTE`** tells the model to read `[capabilities]` before declaring an app operation unavailable. Nothing here stores a model-authored claim: only a tool receipt can create a route. ## Tests Run from `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests` with Python 3.13 and `PYTHONUTF8=1`, repo root on `PYTHONPATH`: - `pytest test_engine_capabilities.py -q` — **18 passed**: success keeps the route in a later brief; one record per repository; lost sign-in stales and omits it; a rejected create (including a real `Command:/Stdout:/Stderr:/Exit Code:` receipt whose title says "permission denied") keeps the route; a grep/echo/comment mention and a create without an issue URL are not evidence; a multi-line or indented `gh issue create` is recorded; argv-list commands; repository-scoped denial; TTL expiry; ambient tasks; restart. - `pytest test_engine_capabilities.py test_engine_brief.py -q` — **80 passed, 16 subtests passed**. - `test_engine_service.py` / `test_server_scope.py`: 5 failures + 13 errors, identical on the unmodified head of this branch with the same interpreter and `PYTHONPATH` (openjiuwen `AgentSpec` version mismatch), so this change introduces no regression there. - `ruff check` on `engine_brief.py` and the capability tests — clean. (`engine_service.py` has 5 pre-existing F401/F821 findings at the branch head, unrelated to this diff.) - Architecture scan with **both** the base policy (`f02f5d8a`) and this branch's policy — 283 files / 38 checked / **0 findings**; `manifest.py --check` — 56 owners / 0 exceptions. Not run: the complete bridge suite. Its collection needs `pytest-xdist` (not installed here) and `tests/test_model_failure.py` also errors at collection; without `pytest-timeout` the full run hangs, so I stopped it rather than claim a result. ## Limits - Only a route that has already succeeded can be kept. A workspace where `gh` has never run successfully still needs a connector write operation (option B in the issue discussion); this PR does not add one. - Records are workspace-scoped with a 30-day TTL; a lost sign-in or executable marks them stale. ## Verification screenshots DevEco simulator against the isolated deployment (patched runtime on port 20016), same request in both rounds; the keyboard/clipboard area is cropped. The injected `[capabilities]` brief and the `gh: not found` receipt are in the verification comment below. Round 1, no capability record (baseline) — the reply says no GitHub account is connected: Round 2, after a (seeded) capability record — the model attempts `gh issue create` and reports the tool missing: Closes #971
